Pathetic Experience
There was uneven cooling inside the place. The only place which was cool was just below the Air Conditioner but water was leaking from it. We were sweating inside an icecream parlour. The billing system is as good as a TOKEN system where one first pays for his / her order then gives a paperslip to the server who then serves your order.
Though the icecreams were good the service was unsatisfactory.
I have visited many Naturals outlets but have never come across such staff who was disinterested in serving customers.

featured_reviews.name: Bhadra Mohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
A friendly and inviting spot that instantly gives off a warm, familiar vibe 🙂🍨
The place is usually buzzing with people who know exactly what they’re here for — fresh, fruit-based ice creams that have a honest, natural taste.

Flavours feel genuine and refreshing, especially favourites like tender coconut, sitaphal, mango, and chikoo 🌿🍧
Scoops are creamy without feeling heavy, and the fruit pieces in many flavours add a nice touch. Pricing is fair for the quality, and everything is served quickly.

Staff members are polite and efficient, keeping the line moving even on busy evenings 🙌✨
A dependable go-to for anyone craving simple, flavourful ice cream made from real ingredients.

featured_reviews.name: Priya Narayan
featured_reviews.review_text: The place had run out of most flavours when we visited this place. Price is reasonable but taste is average, not like before. The AC was leaking so that portion of the bench couldn't be occupied. Staff is overall cold and in a rush. The amount of added sugar in most of the flavours has increased masking the real flavours.

featured_reviews.name: Knightz
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is where it all began Naturally 😉

featured_reviews.review_text: The experience was fine. Too much crowd and long queues and my tender coconut flavour ice cream didn't taste that great. featured_reviews.name: Kalpesh Kherade
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried Mango Malai ice cream here after having it at many other naturals, and this was honestly the worst experience. What disappointed me even more was the staff’s response after I complained — they didn’t even have the courtesy to replace the ice cream or offer any solution. Very poor customer service and not worth…

featured_reviews.name: Akhil Korgaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Was craving for ice-cream so visited Ice-cream Works located in Juhu. They have a wide selection of ice cream and ice cream shakes.
There are indoor seating options available.
The staff is extremely courteous to their customers.
In terms of the order we had:
Sizzling brownie : This simply irresistible, mouth watering, delicious, addictive Sizzling Brownie is all that you could ask for. Made with super soft brownie, super cool ice cream and even super awesome goodness of chocolate sauce, served hot on a sizzler plate. What more could you ask for. Try it right now!
Choco hazelnut shake: A creamy concoction with flavours of chocolate, cocoa powder and hazelnut. It reminds me of a healthy milkshake!
caramel cream shake : This caramel shake is a total sweet caramel dream. Drizzling extra caramel sauce around the inside of a glass & Topped with whipped cream and more caramel
cookie & coffee shake : This magical combination has been my fave for a long time. While each flavor is incredibly complex and delightful on its own, put them together and your taste buds will literally sing and dance with pure joy. I’m sure there is a scientific reason why these 2 items create such an epic combination
Do pay them a visit

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Ice Cream Works in Juhu-Vile Parle, a cozy and inviting place with several outlets around Mumbai. They’re celebrating Friendship Day with a great offer: buy one scoop and get another free. It’s a fantastic chance to hang out with friends and enjoy some delicious ice cream.

We tried the double scoop chocolate brownie, which was amazing, and the triple chocolate sandwich that brought back school day memories. My friends and I also loved the Mahableshwar strawberry milkshake, which had great presentation, and the Mahableshwar cake roll, which was delicious. The king chocolate nashta was also excellent, and the chocolate cone with butterscotch was simply mouthwatering. We ended with an assorted cone featuring regular paan, double strawberry, and big fan fruit flavors, all of which were tasty and satisfying.

If you’re a dessert lover, this place is a must-visit. So, gather your friends and head over to Ice Cream Works to make the most of their Friendship Day offer!

We highly recommend this place to all ice-cream lovers!

Visit to Juhu is definitely incomplete if not had an ice cream at this place!

featured_reviews.review_text: I had a fantastic experience at the ice cream parlour, thanks to Vinod! He was extremely polite, patient, and helpful in recommending flavours based on my preferences. The ice cream was fresh, creamy, and absolutely delicious. The place was clean and had a great vibe. Vinod truly made the visit more enjoyable with his warm and friendly attitude. featured_reviews.name: Styletravelzest !!!
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you have a sweet tooth and crave something chilled to beat this scorching summer heat then Ice Cream Works is a place to visit to satiate your craving. This outlet is located in Juhu opposite Ramada Plaza Hotel, very close to Juhu Beach...

The decor and the seatings are really nice, cool and comfortable. The staff is also very accomodating and helped us in choosing the right combination of flavors.
Avinash, Dharmendra & Hitesh at the counter were extremely humble, courteous and welcoming...
They have a variety of Ice Cream flavors and all are really mouth-watering.

We tried these Ice Creams during our visit :-

1) Triple cone ice cream (Mango, Pink Guava and Calcutta Meetha Paan served in a Special Waffle Cone)
Really loved the Triple Cone Ice Cream with three distinct flavours and different colours. My favourite one was Pink Guava Ice Cream as the flavour enhances when you add a pinch of salt to it and tastes really wonderful. Loved the paan flavour as well as if we were enjoying a chilled paan. The Pink Guava Ice Cream is highly recommended, must try.

2) Triple cone ice cream (Double Strawberry Chocolate Chip Ice Cream, Madagascar Fine Chocolate Ice Cream and Pink Guava served in a Chocolate Waffle Cone)
One of a kind mix of different flavours of Ice Cream that you can have. The Strawberry Chocolate Chip Ice Cream had chunks of Strawberry and Chocolate chips in it and it tasted really amazing. Chocolate Madagascar icecream is highly recommended...

3) Fruit Cocktail Tower - Served in a beautiful long glass contained the following ingredients, Scoop of Vanilla Ice Cream topped with different fruits which was ultimately topped with whipped cream and sprinkle of chocolate syrup. A really delicious Sundae Ice Cream one can devour.

4) Choco Brownie - This Sundae was served in a medium sized glass that had dollops of chocolate brownie with gooey Chocolate Ice Cream at the bottom and topped with whipped cream, choco chips and chocolate syrup drizzle. A must have Sundae Ice Cream.

5) Cookies & Coffee Shake - A Smoothie shake made of Oreo Cookies Ice Cream and splashed with a hint of coffee to give it a really nice taste. Must try for coffee lovers...

6) Ultimate Chocolate Shake - Loads of Chocolate Ice Cream blended and made a thick shake and topped with whipped cream and chocolate syrup. A nice way to beat the heat and my personal favourite.

Must visit place...
Don't miss to try their unique pink guava and chocolate Madagascar icecream...

featured_reviews.review_text:
They have varieties of flavous.
Their service was too friendly and I have to acknowledge their efforts on customization of a dish as per the customer needs!!
Ambiance was pretty decent and modern for a hangout.

featured_reviews.name: The explorer
featured_reviews.review_text:
The freshest ice cream we've had so far. But it melts really quickly too. The icecream scoops from the pictures attached have already started melting by the time they reached our table.! Coming to the flavors, their tiramisu, belgian chocolate, mudpie and many more felt too subtle and are over powered by milk becoming the majority ingredient. But the flavors like mango were really fruity and well made. The unique offerings like orange pistachio, Dubai pistachio ice creams were flavorful and delicious. It'd be great if they come up with more sorbet  offerings.

The staff were kind enough to accommodate serving waffle cones separately. As the icecream melted quickly, cones wouldn't have been the ideal way to have them but the cones were nevertheless freshly prepared and crispy.

The seating arrangement is completely outdoor with their air conditioned interior limited to the "tasting" experience. This could be quite uncomfortable going forward as the summers will scorch up the climate to be able to sit outdoor and enjoy a quickly melting dessert.!

Service staff - quick and warm. The staff at the tasting station are also patient and suggest flavors.
Parking - not sure about the parking availability over weekends as we parked on the street during midday on a weekday.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Naturals Ice Cream

Tried multiple flavours including Mudpie, Tender Coconut, Chocolate Hazelnut, Double Roasted Almond, Spicy Guava, White Chocolate Cherry, along with their Tagdola and Lychee sundaes — and honestly, every single scoop was amazing.

The freshness, unique flavours, and creamy texture make this place stand out every time. Tender Coconut and Chocolate Hazelnut were personal favourites. Perfect place for dessert lovers and family outings.

featured_reviews.name: Bits of Bytes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pretty Good ice creams and Sundaes. They have a rotating menu so they change the menu items every season.

They have live churning counters to witness them live. HQ of Naturals ice-cream is located above the store in the same building. Was able to meet the founders during the launch event several years ago.

I had the Blueberry Cheesy Sundae and my friend had the Tiramisu ice cream.

featured_reviews.name: Chinmay
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very very tasty ice creams! I had the mixed fruit tadgola ice cream, and it was extremely delicious, very fresh too. I wanted to visit this place because some flavours are exclusively available here, and gotta say it was worth the commute! The only issue was the seating, it's outdoor and in summers, during high humidity, it can get hot and humid, there aren't enough fans. Other than that, amazing place, good ice cream
9/10 🍨

featured_reviews.name: Manali Mayekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried the Tadgola Sundae and Caramel Crunch Ice Cream at Juhu Naturals and both were absolutely delicious! The Tadgola Sundae was super refreshing and unique, with a light, natural sweetness that felt perfect for the weather. The Caramel Crunch Ice Cream was rich, creamy, and had the perfect balance of sweetness with a satisfying crunch.

Loved how fresh and natural everything tasted. Definitely a must-try if you’re in the area!

featured_reviews.name: Tushar Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Natural Ice Cream Now for the first time, and I’m honestly so impressed!

What really makes this place stand out is how fresh and natural everything tastes. The flavors aren’t overly sweet or artificial—you can actually taste the real ingredients, which makes a huge difference.

I tried the Tadgola Sundae, and it was absolutely amazing. It’s made with fresh pieces of tadgola (ice apple) paired with their rich and creamy malai ice cream. The combination was perfect—light, refreshing, and super satisfying. The tadgola added a unique texture and subtle sweetness, while the malai ice cream made it indulgent without being heavy.

Highly recommend trying their seasonal and fruit-based options. I’ll definitely be coming back to explore more flavors!

featured_reviews.name: Mitesh Goyani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Naturals Now Ice Cream continues to be our all-time favourite, and this visit was no different. We genuinely love almost everything they serve. We tried quite a variety, but the Targola Sundae, as always, was the clear standout.
Now we’re eagerly waiting for mango season to arrive so we can indulge in their Mango Sundae again! The Belgian Chocolate was fantastic, and the Orange Pistachio was equally delightful.
However, the Blueberry Cheesecake and Raspberry felt a bit too strongly flavoured for our liking and could be skipped.
Lovely ambience as always — a perfect place to unwind and enjoy great ice cream.

We've already visited this place a couple of times!!
Love the quality and texture of the ice creams!!
What we ordered -
1. The ice cream noodles dish -4/10, found it too sweet and watery, won't recommend this one,though it's pretty to look at! There are other better dessert options!

2. London Strawberry chocolate -9/10, the strawberries were fresh and the chocolate creamy and sweet

featured_reviews.name: Suyash Karangutkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Gold by Ice Cream Works and had an absolutely delightful experience! We started with their 70% Dark Chocolate Ganache with Choco Rocks scoop — a dream for dark chocolate lovers. It was rich, with just the right balance of bittersweet notes, and the texture of the choco rocks added a perfect crunch, making it wonderfully pallete-balancing.

Next, we tried the Ferro Hazelnut, which was dipped in chocolate and absolutely delicious — a treat that beautifully captured the classic hazelnut and chocolate combination. As a healthier choice, we also sampled their Good-For-You Chocolate (pun game strong!) a chocolate ice cream sweetened with palm jaggery. The natural sweetness of the jaggery was spot on, making it feel indulgent yet light, and we appreciated the clever pun in the name!

The ambiance of the place was cozy and inviting, and the staff were extremely welcoming, cordial, and helpful in suggesting flavors based on our preferences. They made the experience even more enjoyable.

We also noticed an entire section dedicated to caramel ice-cream cakes, which looked very tempting — definitely on our list for the next visit! Plus, their Sundae menu is quite elaborate, offering plenty of options for those looking to indulge.

Overall, a must-visit spot for ice cream and dessert enthusiasts. Can’t wait to go back and try more!

featured_reviews.name: Varun Poduval
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent ice cream parlour. Great service. Wide variety of flavours. Premium feels. The sweetness could be a little moderated. The place is a little expensive but wonderful overall experience especially the service.

featured_reviews.name: Image Com
featured_reviews.review_text: Totally obsessed with Ice Cream Works at Bandra! Their unique flavors and artistic presentation are a treat for the eyes and taste buds. The ambiance is super luxurious and perfect for a dessert date. Highly recommend for anyone with a sweet tooth.

featured_reviews.name: Shaikh Khalid Sarfaraz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Gold by ICW is located off Linking Road Bandra West and they have another outlet in Juhu.

The outlet is super bright, spacious and nicely made with the hint of gold colours used. The big display of the products looks excellent and everything is nicely placed here. Loved the seatings as it can accommodate all size of groups.

They specialise in premium flavours which are unique and give you an artisanal experience. Every flavour is amazing here and the menu is never ending. Also they have a kid centric special menu which is really good. Loved the sundaes as they are completely Instgrammable. Prices are on the higher side however the quantity and quantity are unmatched.

Went here after dinner and the staff were really polite and they knew their brand well. Special thanks to Manager Imran & Staff Tausif for their service.

What We Had -
SCOOPS~
3 Berries Cheesecake.
Biscotti Chocolate Cookie Fudge.
Both the flavours were bang on tasty and it was not overly sweet. The taste of tangy sweet berries was evident and the chocolate cookie fudge had cookie crumbs put nicely.

SUNDAES~
Chocolate in Gold Perfection.
Alphonso Mango.
They are the masters in preparing sundaes as the mix of flavours plus presentation is top class.  Chocolate in gold perfection was way too heavy for the appetite as it had everything related to chocolate in it. The best was the Alphonso mango from their limited edition menu which was outstanding.

MILKSHAKES~
Pistachio Opulence.
Alphanso Mango Milkshake.
Amazingly thick shakes made perfectly which tasted excellent. Loved the pistachio opulence and it should definitely be tried. Again not too sweet but tasty till the last drop.

So our dessert trip at Gold by ICW Bandra was something different as the Gourmet flavours and the classy outlet is something you need to visit for a memorable dessert experience.

featured_reviews.name: vishal sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
After a delicious dinner, we decided to end the night on a sweet note and stopped by By Ice Cream. It turned out to be the perfect choice for a decadent dessert experience!

Ambiance:
The place has a clean with comfortable seating, making it a nice spot to relax and enjoy your treat.

Service:
The service was quick and efficient. The staff was polite and helped us choose from their rich range of chocolate-based flavors.

Ice Creams Tried:
70% Dark Chocolate Ganache Ice Cream: Deep, intense, and a must-try for dark chocolate lovers.

The Ferrero rocher Ice cream : Creamy and perfectly sweet without being overwhelming and had a perfectly balanced taste of Ferrero rocher.

Good-for-you Chocolate Ice Cream: Rich, indulgent and made up of jaggery instead of sugar.

Ice Cream works impressed us with their strong chocolatey offerings and smooth textures. It's a definite go-to spot for anyone with a sweet tooth looking for something indulgent yet refined.

featured_reviews.name: Muhammad Ibrahim C.A
featured_reviews.review_text:
It's ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ For Juhu Sealand

If you’re looking for the ultimate treat to cool you down at the beach, Juhusealand Falooda Shop is an absolute must-visit! Their falooda is nothing short of spectacular—each spoonful is a delightful blend of silky vermicelli, creamy kulfi, and perfectly sweet rose syrup. The texture is just right, offering a heavenly balance between smooth and crunchy with the addition of sweet basil seeds.

But what truly steals the show is their beach gola. It’s a vibrant explosion of flavors, with ice shavings so fine that they melt in your mouth, drenched in colorful syrups that bring back the nostalgia of childhood summers. It’s no wonder this has become everyone’s favorite! The refreshing and fruity taste is the perfect way to beat the heat while lounging on the sand.

The atmosphere is inviting, and the staff are always friendly, adding to the overall experience. Juhusealand isn’t just a shop; it’s a delightful destination for anyone craving a sweet escape. Don’t miss out on this gem—your taste buds will thank you!

featured_reviews.name: ibrahim
featured_reviews.review_text:
Juhusealand Falooda Shop is an absolute treasure and a must-visit for anyone who loves a delicious treat! Their falooda is simply out of this world—perfectly crafted with layers of silky vermicelli, luscious rose syrup, and creamy kulfi that will leave you craving more. Each bite is a delightful symphony of flavors and textures, making it the best falooda I’ve ever had!

And then there’s the beach gola! This is hands down the star of the show. The ice is incredibly fine, creating a melt-in-your-mouth experience, and it’s generously drizzled with vibrant, fruity syrups that burst with flavor. It’s no surprise that this refreshing treat has become a favorite among beachgoers—it’s the perfect way to cool off and indulge at the same time.

The freshness of the ingredients really shines through, and you can taste the love and care that goes into every dish. The friendly staff and inviting atmosphere make your visit even more enjoyable. Trust me, everyone should make it a point to visit Juhusealand Falooda Shop at least once in their life! It’s an unforgettable experience that will leave you smiling and satisfied. Don’t miss out on this amazing gem!
